figurative_meaning_en: arrangements, preparations, efforts, and hard work
example_sentences_in_bangla: অনেক কাঠখড় পোড়িয়ে সে পরীক্ষায় উত্তীর্ণ হয়েছে।
বিয়ের আয়োজনে অনেক কাঠখড় পোড়াতে হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He passed the exam after burning a lot of firewood and straw (i.e., putting in immense effort).
The wedding arrangements required burning a lot of firewood and straw (i.e., extensive preparations).
history: Originates from rural Bengali life where burning wood and straw in traditional hearths symbolizes the fuel (effort) needed for tasks like cooking or ceremonies.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of laborious fire-making in village settings, emphasizing persistence.
